test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

I watched him with the excitement of ______ him to do anything at any time.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**expecting**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is talking about the speaker watching someone with excitement.
 
• The word "**expecting**" means anticipating or waiting for something to happen. (उम्मीद)<
